verdict.rationale: The M4 Max is a processor (SoC). Choosing a data storage region or residency is a cloud-service axis, so this is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence about on-device AI and unified memory concerns local compute, not a user-selectable storage region, and does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
